item.title: Forget ‘Carrie,’ Mike Flanagan’s Best Netflix Miniseries Is a Masterpiece From Start to Finish
item.description: Long before he was at the helm of the Prime Video adaptation of Stephen King's Carrie, Mike Flanagan made waves for himself with his trilogy of Netflix TV miniseries . His ability to helm works that combine horror and genuine human exploration. Recently, The Fall of the House of Usher reimagined classic Edgar Allan Poe tales to terrifying success, with each episode adapting a different story.

item.title: Red Rising Is Officially Returning In 2027
item.description: In the early 2010s, The Hunger Games captivated a generation, and in its wake came another dystopian tale set in the stars. Red Rising , a six-book saga by author Pierce Brown, traded the death-match arena for Mars, where a rigid, color-coded class system dictates daily life on the Red Planet. "Golds" are the most elite nenbers of Mars society, and they rule over the other colored classes, including the lowest class, "Reds." Much like Katniss Everdeen became the face of a revolution in The Hunger Games , Darrow, a lowborn "Red" miner, becomes the face of Red Rising's revolution.

item.title: Shrek 2 Remastered Officially Announced With Must-See GTA 6-inspired Trailer
item.description: Rockstar Games has spent years building hype for Grand Theft Auto 6 , with every trailer and update becoming a major event for fans. But what if that same dramatic treatment was applied to a very different kind of video game? One starring a certain green ogre , perhaps?

item.title: Henry Cavill’s Upcoming Sci-Fi Space Opera Series Writer Admits It's Been ‘Brutally Difficult’
item.description: Mike Flanagan has spent years bringing some of horror's most beloved stories to the screen, from Stephen King's Doctor Sleep to Netflix's The Haunting of Hill House . His latest King adaptation, Carrie , has earned rave reviews and is dominating streaming on Prime Video, but the filmmaker's next major undertaking might be his most daunting yet: bringing the sprawling science-fiction universe of Warhammer 40,000 to live action.

item.title: 20 Best Board Wipes in Magic: The Gathering
item.description: While early sweepers simply destroyed everything in sight, decades of card design have led to a fascinating variety of board wipe functionality. Modern alternatives often bypass indestructible keywords and death triggers using non-targeting exile effects or mass toughness penalties like -X/-X. Other variations leverage cost-reduction mechanics, instant-speed mass bouncing, or modular options, allowing players to turn a seemingly symmetrical effect into a devastating advantage.

item.title: Next-gen Xbox Could Cost Up to $1,800, New Report Says
item.description: It's no secret that the cost of video game hardware and computer components has been dramatically rising. We also know that the price of the next-generation Xbox console, codenamed Project Helix , is expected to be high. Microsoft has positioned Project Helix as a “ very premium, very high end ” device that's akin to a powerful gaming PC. But a new report puts the projected cost of the next Xbox console in stark relief: According to Microsoft's internal estimates, it could cost as much as $1,800.

item.title: Fallout 4: FEVer Dreams Gets Official Surprise Release
item.description: Bethesda just gave everyone a solid reason to boot up Fallout 4 again — even if you've already racked up hundreds of hours in the post-apocalyptic RPG and its many expansions. A new release brings back Courtenay Taylor and Brian T. Delaney, the original actors who voiced Fallout 4 's protagonists. This new adventure won't be like anything else you've encountered in the wasteland, though.

item.title: A New DC Green Lantern Has Officially Been Unveiled
item.description: HBO's Lanterns may have just ended with no second season in sight yet , but Green Lantern fans still have a promising new interpretation of the classic DC hero to look forward to. DC Comics announced Green Lantern: Doomed Cosmos on Tuesday, a miniseries with a unique take on the Green Lantern corps.

item.title: New Cheaper PS5 Officially Available for Pre-Order Now
item.description: With the cost of a PlayStation 5 going up and up in price since the console's launch in 2020, late adopters are looking at a $599 entry-level price if they want to play Grand Theft Auto 6 on PS5 this November. While the current generation of consoles is bucking the trend that dedicated gaming devices typically go down in price over time — thanks a lot, generative AI speculation! — Sony is offering some small amount of relief to one market with a new PlayStation 5 console that costs around $350.
